data.gender_notes: Cayetana is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Spanish name 'Cayetana', which originated from the name Caietas, a Roman goddess of the forest and wild animals. The name Cayetana means 'rejoicing' or 'pure'. The name Cayetana carries the meaning “Rejoicing, pure” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cayetana usually hope their child will grow to embody rejoicing, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
